To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
calvarial bone is more suitable than iliac bone as a donor site for transport segment in bifocal transport for reconstruction of large osseous defects of the calvary.

transport segments consisting of autogenous regional calvarial bone and autogenous iliac bone grafts resulted both in a complete closure and in a reliable reconstruction of critical size defects of adult calvaria, and that the application of calvairal bone grafts resulted significantly in an increased extend and volume of newly formed bone.
the use of calvarial transport segment results in a significantly larger bone formation than the application of iliac transport segments in a model of bifocal transport osteosynthesis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a technique for reconstruction of extended osseo-cranio-facial defects.
a new approach in craniofacial surgery, the application of transport osteogenesis in the treatment of large craniofacial osseous defects.
the development of new techniques to reconstruct extended osseous defects of the calva.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of autogenous calvarial free bone grafts is preferable to autogenous iliac bone grafts in BTO.
BTO with calvarial bone transport segment is a reliable and promising technique for reconstruction of large craniofacial osseous defects in adult animals.
BTO using calvarial bone is the method of choice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
calvarial bone is a suitable donor site for transport osteogenesis.
calvarial bone is the most favorable bone graft for the reconstruction of critical size craniofacial bone defects by BTO.
the use of autogenous bone grafts in BTO results in a reliable reconstruction of craniofacially extended defects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
BTO is a promising method to reconstruct extended osseous defects in the calvaria.
calvarial bone is a better donor material for the BTO technique in the reconstruction of craniofacially extended bone defects.
the application of calvalrial bone grafts results in an increased extent of bone formation.
